verdicts.why: The check detects that Kernel receives business-confidential answers, while a projection made personal_data by its populated alias is refused as answer_above_class. It also verifies whole-answer refusal by checking the refusal-only key set and absence of the alias value, thereby establishing Kernel's exact highest class as business_confidential.
